resources.string: Scan the setup QR code from qrconfig, or enter the API endpoint and API key of your deployment. The key is encrypted on this device; you confirm with your fingerprint or screen lock to save it.
That QR code is not a Deadman\'s Handle setup code.
That setup code is version %1$d, which this app doesn\'t know. Update the app.
That setup code has a missing or invalid endpoint or API key.
Google Play services is downloading the QR scanner. Try again in a minute, or enter the config by hand.
The QR code could not be scanned: %1$s
Enter an https URL, such as https://abc123.execute-api.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com
Set a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password) in Settings first. The API key can only be stored on a device that has one.
The config could not be saved: %1$s
The screen lock on this device was removed, so the saved config can no longer be used. Enter it again.
